source.storyText:
Rainbowland is a place that started where the rainbow started and ended where it ended. So it was a huge place where there was room for everybody. Rainbowland was full of dreamers who were dreaming wonderful dreams and when they could not let go of their dreams, they ended up here. Some daydreamers also entered Rainbowland for a short time. That is why people say "she is in another world" when someone is daydreaming. Dreamers sometimes create dreams that are so bright, and real that it is not like a dream at all. The dream glistens and shines with many colours. This colourful call of the dream attracts a smoky white ship from Rainbowland. Chugging along, it reaches the doorstep of the dreamer. Only the dreamer sees the ship, and that too, in his dreams. The dreamer, still dreaming, steps into the ship. The dreamer has not yet decided whether he wants to live in Rainbowland forever or not . So he leaves his body behind just in case he wants to return. And off he goes. The ship sails for 6 days and 6 nights and finally reaches Rainbowland. And what a beautiful place it is!

People in Rainblowland can do wonderful things. They can hang upside down, fly, sink deep into the ground or enter the skies. If they want they can break into many pieces and then come together again. Why would they want to break into many pieces you say ? Well if they break into 10 pieces and each piece falls from the sky saying "wheeee" with delight, then it becomes 10 times the fun!
